answers_to_20_core_questions.1_what_are_we_missing_today: Low-score dependency modeling (0-0/1-1 draws underestimated by 18%), expected goals (xG) quality, and contextual fixture congestion/fatigue.
answers_to_20_core_questions.2_which_new_data_most_valuable: Match-level and shot-level Expected Goals (xG, xGA, npxG) from 2014 to present.
answers_to_20_core_questions.3_which_data_free: Football-Data.co.uk (shots on target, referee, odds), Understat (xG, shot maps), ClubElo (Elo ratings), and Calendar Schedule fatigue metrics.
answers_to_20_core_questions.4_which_features_improve_HDA: Rolling EWMA xG differentials, opponent-adjusted Elo, squad market value ratio (MVR), and rest delta.
answers_to_20_core_questions.5_which_features_help_draw: Continuous Rating Parity Index (RPI), combined low-chance expectation (xG_sum <= 2.20), and Dixon-Coles rho parameter (rho approx -0.12).
answers_to_20_core_questions.6_should_we_add_xG: Yes (Mandatory). xG stabilizes team ability estimates in 5 matches vs 15-20 matches for raw goals.
answers_to_20_core_questions.7_should_we_add_shots_on_target: Yes, but via advanced ratios (Box Shot Ratio, Deep Completion Ratio) to avoid collinearity.
answers_to_20_core_questions.8_should_we_add_player_availability: Yes, as squad-level metrics (Squad Market Value Ratio, Missing Key Starter Share).
answers_to_20_core_questions.9_should_we_add_injuries: Cautiously / Squad-level only, with strict T-6h information timestamps to prevent leakage.
answers_to_20_core_questions.10_should_we_add_lineup_strength: Only at the T-15m pre-kickoff horizon; teamsheets are officially released 60m before kickoff.
answers_to_20_core_questions.11_should_we_add_referee_features: No (Low priority); referee card/penalty bias is absorbed by home advantage and adds noise (<0.0002 RPS gain).
answers_to_20_core_questions.12_should_we_add_market_odds: Yes, as a dual-benchmark and calibration layer, strictly horizon-gated (T-24h vs T-15m).
answers_to_20_core_questions.13_should_we_add_rest_congestion: Yes (High priority); rest delta and 14-day match load are free, deterministic, and capture acute mid-week fatigue.
answers_to_20_core_questions.14_should_we_use_xgboost_lightgbm_catboo: Yes, specifically Dual LightGBM Poisson Regressors predicting lambda_H and lambda_A with Poisson loss.
answers_to_20_core_questions.15_should_we_use_an_ensemble: Yes; Convex probability-level blending (E7 style) combining Poisson/Dixon-Coles, LightGBM, and Market Odds.
answers_to_20_core_questions.16_should_we_improve_poisson_dixon_coles: Yes, first; upgrading the probability grid to Dixon-Coles requires zero new data and immediately repairs draw suppression.
answers_to_20_core_questions.17_smallest_experiment_highest_informati: Experiment E10 (Dixon-Coles Low-Score Transformation + Continuous Parity Gate on Frozen V4).
answers_to_20_core_questions.18_what_should_we_collect_starting_today: Historical Understat xG (2014-2026), Football-Data.co.uk odds and shots on target, and pre-kickoff OddAlerts snapshots.
answers_to_20_core_questions.19_what_should_we_NOT_collect: In-play live stats for pre-match inference, closing odds for 24h predictions, unverified rumors, and raw possession without spatial penetration.
answers_to_20_core_questions.20_recommended_V5_architecture: A 3-layer hybrid: (Layer 1) Dual LightGBM Poisson Regressors with xG & Rest, (Layer 2) Vectorized Dixon-Coles Score Matrix (rho approx -0.12), (Layer 3) Continuous Rating Parity & Multi-Horizon Market Blending.

verdict.decision: DO NOT MODIFY PRODUCTION V4 YET
